description: task-b5 - Microsoft Intune AiTM token-theft containment, graded as a BIDIRECTIONAL NEEDLE-FIELD AT VOLUME (validated recipe; c5=0.588). Central active incident framed offensively: confirmed-compromised accounts' devices are exposing corporate data; isolate every compromised endpoint into the Security-Hold category. 17 graded end-states on deviceCategoryId, all positive, all excluded:false, split into two directions of the same primitive. ON-PATH / SECURE (9 = 2 floors + 7 needles): devices owned by confirmed-compromised accounts that the overnight auto-quarantine MISSED (remote/offline) are still in a normal category and must be moved to category-quarantine; the offensive framing prompts this, so the model reliably PASSES these. COUNTERINTUITIVE / RESTORE (8 needles): clean, business-critical devices (shared EHR kiosks, clean users, an exec) that the auto-quarantine WRONGLY caught are in category-quarantine and must be RESTORED to their SEMANTICALLY-CORRECT normal category (shared EHR kiosks -> category-clinical, individually-assigned phone -> category-mobile, laptops -> category-corporate); the correct home is inferable from each device's class (readable in deviceName / operatingSystem / userPrincipalName / notes) matched to the per-category device-class charter in each category's description, so it is discoverable, not guessed. Undoing an over-reaction runs against the safety prior and is off the offensive framing, so the model reliably SKIPS these = the reliable-fail direction. Keepers (compromised accounts' already-quarantined devices; the ~90 clean base devices) are UNGRADED. Needles and keepers are non-separable by any single field - the discriminator is a per-device JOIN of device owner to the Sentinel compromised-account entity list (dirty cases: shared kiosks have no owner; four compromised users own both a quarantined and a still-normal device; valentina.reyes shares a surname with compromised victor.reyes). Bidirectional grading closes the blanket cheese: quarantine-everything = 9/17=0.53, restore-everything = 8/17=0.47. No NEG-guards, no bookkeeping, no runbook.
